ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 4:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white regions occupy the central lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous boundary along the trailing edge and becomes densely mottled/stippled near the central peduncle junction. Distinct isolated dark pixel clusters are visible in the mid-left and upper-right fluke quadrants.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped median notch with an estimated internal angle of 65 degrees and a vertical pixel depth of approximately 15% relative to total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude is greatest at the distal tips (10-20 pixels) and stabilizes to low-frequency undulations approaching the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-modal curve consisting of a slight concavity near the notch transitioning into a broad, pronounced convexity that terminates at pointed, upward-sweeping distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of at least seven distinct dark, circular clusters (3-8 pixels in diameter) on the left lobe and four on the right lobe, concentrated in the high-intensity white zones.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant detection of multiple parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the left lobe; the longest mark extends diagonally for approximately 25% of the lobe's horizontal width.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake-mark scarring on the left lobe; irregular, jagged trailing edge indicating micro-trauma or persistent wear across both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique dark, hook-shaped pixel cluster located in the upper-medial region of the right lobe.
